The image shows a sugarcane leaf with a prominent white/pale longitudinal stripe running parallel to the veins from the midrib toward the leaf margin, with a diffuse yellowish border around it. The rest of the leaf is dark green.

**Key features observed:**
- White pencil-line stripe (~1-2 mm wide) running parallel to leaf veins
- Diffuse yellow border flanking the white stripe
- No mosaic/mottled patterns (rules out Mosaic Virus / SCSMV)
- No numerous small streaks (rules out Streak_Mosaic_Scsmv)
- No midrib yellowing pattern (rules out Yellow_Leaf)
- Single, clean white line rather than multiple interveinal streaks

This matches **Leaf_Scald** exactly: "a white pencil line on leaves extending from the midrib to the margin with a diffuse yellow border."
